request-limit.message: Work paused at the approved request limit.

provider-limit.message: The AI provider stopped this run at its limit.

context-limit.message: The current AI context exceeds its configured budget. Saved work is retained; reduce the current request or read smaller context sections.

authentication.message: The AI connection needs authentication. Check its credentials or sign in again.

permission.message: This AI connection does not allow the requested operation. Check access and enabled models.

configuration.message: The AI connection is unavailable or needs configuration. Check it in Admin.

busy.message: The AI connection is busy. No new operation was admitted.

rate-limited.message: The AI provider is limiting requests. Wait before trying again.

unavailable.message: The AI service is temporarily unavailable. Completed work is retained.

connection-lost.message: The AI connection ended before completion. Review completed work before continuing.

timeout.message: The AI request timed out. Its outcome may be uncertain; review completed work before continuing.

invalid-request.message: The AI request was rejected. Check the selected model and request settings before trying again.

invalid-response.message: The AI returned no usable complete response. Completed work is retained.

storage.message: Progress could not be saved. Keep this window open and restore storage before continuing.

stale-state.message: The saved context or configuration changed. Reload the current state before continuing.

tool-failed.message: The tool could not complete this operation. Check its result before repeating it.

unknown.message: The response could not complete. Review completed work before continuing.

retries-exhausted.message: The AI connection could not recover after automatic retries. Review completed work before continuing.

invalid-tool-input.message: The tool input needs correction before this operation can continue.

output-limit.message: The AI reached its output-token limit before completing the response. Completed work is retained.

content-filter.message: The AI provider blocked this response. Review the request before continuing.

repeated-work.message: The assistant kept repeating completed work. Desk stopped this response and retained the results.

pace exceeded.message: The project period budget is exhausted. Wait for the next period or change the project policy.
